facts.text: I am trying to keep track of my grocery expenses.
I want help making a list of all the grocery stores I've been to recently.
I stopped by a corner store on Monday.
I spent $2.50 on a gallon of milk at the corner store on Monday.
I bought chicken breasts at Walmart.
I used the last of the chicken breasts I bought at Walmart to make chicken sandwiches for lunch yesterday.
I got cauliflower gnocchi from Trader Joe's.
